ASMBOOK.name: ASMBOOK
ASMBOOK.summary: A notebook that lets you look inside the machine. Write 8086 assembly, inspect the CPU, and follow every instruction.

caseStudy.intro: An interactive assembly notebook with lessons and an inspectable CPU.
caseStudy.challenge: Assembly becomes easier to reason about when instructions, registers, and execution can be examined together.
caseStudy.approach: Preact and TypeScript organize the notebook interface. Browser emulation and execution views bring the low-level program into an accessible environment.
caseStudy.outcome: A deployed browser notebook visitors can explore without installing a local assembly toolchain.
caseStudy.limitations: An educational environment; emulator and lesson behavior should be evaluated for the particular instruction being studied.

algorithms-visualizer.name: AlgoViz
algorithms-visualizer.summary: Watch an algorithm think. Step through sorting, searching, graphs, and data structures at your own pace.

caseStudy.intro: A collection of interactive algorithm and data-structure visualizations.
caseStudy.challenge: A final sorted list hides the comparisons, swaps, and intermediate states that explain an algorithm.
caseStudy.approach: Vanilla JavaScript modules separate algorithm behavior from the interface. Playback turns intermediate states into something visitors can follow.
caseStudy.outcome: A public visual playground spanning sorting, searching, graph algorithms, and data structures.
caseStudy.limitations: Visual examples teach behavior; browser animation timings are not reliable algorithm benchmarks.

RetinoTwin.name: RetinoTwin
RetinoTwin.summary: Explore synthetic eye anatomy and imaging through an educational digital-twin prototype.

caseStudy.intro: An educational prototype for synthetic eye anatomy and multimodal imaging exploration.
caseStudy.challenge: Present anatomy and imaging concepts in an interactive interface while making the limits of synthetic data clear.
caseStudy.approach: Next.js and React organize the interface with Three.js and state management supporting interactive views. The current eye presentation includes an SVG cutaway.
caseStudy.outcome: A publicly accessible prototype for exploring the model and its controls.
caseStudy.limitations: Educational synthetic visualization, not a medical device, diagnostic system, or validated patient-specific prediction.

Game-Database-Project.name: Super Tic-Tac-Toe
Game-Database-Project.summary: Nine boards. One bigger game. A multiplayer experiment in strategy, tournaments, and real-time play.

caseStudy.intro: A game and tournament platform built around Super Tic-Tac-Toe.
caseStudy.challenge: A multiplayer game must communicate board state clearly while coordinating actions between players.
caseStudy.approach: A React and TypeScript client connects to an Express and Socket.IO backend. The repository also includes academic database documentation.
caseStudy.outcome: A hosted game interface with a source repository documenting the broader system.
caseStudy.limitations: The free Render service may need time to wake. Multiplayer depends on backend availability and other participants.

PakimonGO.name: PakimonGO
PakimonGO.summary: Turn a real animal sighting into a discovery. Photograph wildlife, explore the map, and build a collection.

caseStudy.intro: A wildlife photography app with discovery, collections, maps, and competition.
caseStudy.challenge: Connect real-world photographs to an engaging collection and exploration experience.
caseStudy.approach: Flutter provides the mobile interface. FastAPI supports server behavior, with PostgreSQL, Firebase, and vision services documented in the project.
caseStudy.outcome: An Android alpha release and a public repository containing application screenshots and architecture notes.
caseStudy.limitations: The app requires Android and relevant service availability. This portfolio presents real screenshots rather than simulating a working mobile app.

Doomsday-Algorithm-In-Assembly-Language.name: Doomsday / Assembly
Doomsday-Algorithm-In-Assembly-Language.summary: Find the weekday of any date, with handwritten assembly running inside your browser.

caseStudy.intro: An assembly implementation of Conway’s weekday calculation method presented in a browser environment.
caseStudy.challenge: Make a low-level mathematical program approachable without requiring a visitor to configure DOS tools.
caseStudy.approach: Handwritten NASM runs through a browser DOSBox/WebAssembly environment, with an interactive application and source views.
caseStudy.outcome: A public demonstration linking calendar arithmetic with assembly programming.
caseStudy.limitations: Dates and execution follow the original program’s supported input rules. Browser emulation is a demonstration environment.

Visualizers.name: Transformer Visualizer
Visualizers.summary: A closer look at attention, tokens, and the ideas inside machine learning. Part of an expanding visualizer collection.

caseStudy.intro: A collection of visual experiments including transformer concepts and Gaussian Naive Bayes.
caseStudy.challenge: Translate abstract machine-learning operations into controls and relationships people can explore.
caseStudy.approach: Browser-native visual interfaces present model concepts without asking visitors to set up a notebook environment.
caseStudy.outcome: Public transformer and Naive Bayes demonstrations, alongside an additional timezone-clock experiment.
caseStudy.limitations: Conceptual visualization is not evidence of production model training or measured predictive performance.

cli-chatbot.name: Mirage Terminal
cli-chatbot.summary: A terminal-shaped playground for AI. Explore a simulated shell, agent interfaces, and conversational tools.

caseStudy.intro: A web terminal with simulated PowerShell and AI CLI interfaces.
caseStudy.challenge: Bring the familiarity of a terminal to a browser interface that can work on smaller screens.
caseStudy.approach: Next.js, React, xterm.js, and Zustand support the terminal experience. Simulated shell activity and AI responses are distinct parts of the system.
caseStudy.outcome: A deployed terminal interface that opens from this portfolio in its own tab.
caseStudy.limitations: The deployment blocks embedding. Shell/tool activity is simulated; AI replies depend on the configured service.

kaggle-run-skill.name: kaggle-run-skill
kaggle-run-skill.summary: A small command surface for a big workflow. Deploy notebooks, inspect runs, and work with Kaggle from coding agents.

caseStudy.intro: Kaggle workflow tooling for AI coding agents, including notebook deployment and competition workflows.
caseStudy.challenge: Reduce repeated manual steps while keeping a coding agent’s context focused on the current task.
caseStudy.approach: A compact skill router points to purpose-specific Python scripts. The repository documents notebook runs, error handling, and supported agent integrations.
caseStudy.outcome: A reusable public skill with source, installation guidance, and examples.
caseStudy.limitations: Actual Kaggle operations need the user’s own credentials and appropriate competition permissions. This portfolio never submits jobs on a visitor’s behalf.

Nano-Swarm-Intelligence-Coronary-Clot-Si.name: Nano-Swarm
Nano-Swarm-Intelligence-Coronary-Clot-Si.summary: Guide a swarm through a simulated artery. Change the parameters and watch coordination emerge.

caseStudy.intro: A browser-first educational simulation of coordinated microrobot-inspired agents interacting with a clot.
caseStudy.challenge: Explain swarm coordination through a repeatable interactive model with visible controls and metrics.
caseStudy.approach: TypeScript separates deterministic simulation, rendering, guided playback, metrics, and exports. Three.js presents the pseudo-3D artery scene.
caseStudy.outcome: The original application is built from a pinned source revision and hosted alongside this portfolio.
caseStudy.limitations: Simplified educational visualization only: not a medical device, not patient-specific, and not predictive of treatment outcomes.

TOP-10-NLP-ALGORITHMS-SIMULATORS.name: NLP Reference Lab
TOP-10-NLP-ALGORITHMS-SIMULATORS.summary: Explore precomputed reference runs for 13 NLP algorithms. The hosted player replays examples; custom input is not executed.

North-Korea-Sort.name: North Korea Sort
North-Korea-Sort.summary: A satirical sorting cartoon with animation and audio. A playful experiment from the archive.

RepoDoctor-Deploy.name: RepoDoctor
RepoDoctor-Deploy.summary: A landing-page preview for a multi-agent repository auditor. Running the auditor requires its backend.

Software-Engineering-Project--UTOS.name: UTOS
Software-Engineering-Project--UTOS.attribution: University timetabling course project created with a team; see the repository for contributors.

mcq-maker.name: MCQ Maker
mcq-maker.summary: A reusable skill that turns documents into quizzes. Try an existing example quiz in the browser.

Mafia-Host-Tool.name: Mafia Host Tool
Mafia-Host-Tool.summary: A party-game role distribution tool. Its previously published service is currently unavailable; explore the source.

ai-stack.name: AI Stack
ai-stack.summary: A local assistant stack with a model gateway and provider failover. Explore the architecture and configuration in the repository.

books.summary: A collection of reading material. Collected works are credited to their original authors.
books.attribution: Reading collection; not a claim of authorship of the collected books.

hammadshakeelai.name: Behind this site
hammadshakeelai.summary: The source of Hammad’s Lab: one project catalog, an interactive orbital homepage, a 3D world, and a browser desktop.
